description.value:
As a bonus action, you can spend one minute in a confusing stance. As part of that bonus action, and again as a bonus action on later turns, whenever you take the Dodge action you may also make one melee weapon attack against a creature within range. When you do, you may flourish your weapon to try to distract that target: make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by its Wisdom (Perception) check. On a success, you make the attack roll with advantage.

The stance ends early if you're incapacitated or killed. You must finish a long rest before using this feature again.
